question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**falling**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **context of the passage **indicates a scene where snow can be observed through the window.
 
• Snow often "**falls**," making **“falling snow**” the most appropriate and natural phrase to describe the scene.</sp
